neutral: This is not a conversation I can have right now.
recruitment.admire.1: All right. I can see the sense in following someone who has earned my trust.
recruitment.admire.2: I was hoping you would ask. Give me a place in your group and I will pull my weight.
recruitment.admire.3: Yes. I respect what you are building, and I would rather help than stand outside it.
recruitment.fear.1: I do not like being cornered, but I know when I am outmatched. I will come with you.
recruitment.fear.2: Fine. I will follow for now. Keep your word and we will not have a problem.
recruitment.fear.3: You have made your point. I will join, but do not mistake caution for friendship yet.
recruitment.reject.cooldown.1: We already had this conversation today. Give me time to think before you press me again.
recruitment.reject.cooldown.2: Not again today. Let us see how things stand tomorrow.
recruitment.reject.general.1: I cannot make that decision right now. There is too much working against it.
recruitment.reject.general.2: No. I appreciate the offer, but joining you is not possible at the moment.
recruitment.reject.general.3: I need to sort out a few things before I can even consider leaving with you.
recruitment.reject.hostile.1: You want me to join you? Keep your distance.
recruitment.reject.hostile.2: I am not joining you. Do not mistake this conversation for trust.
recruitment.reject.leader.1: I already have people depending on me. I cannot walk away from them for your group.
recruitment.reject.leader.2: I am responsible for this shelter. Until that changes, I am staying here.
recruitment.reject.member.1: You are already with us. Ask me about orders instead of recruiting me again.
recruitment.reject.member.2: I am already part of this group.
recruitment.reject.relationship.1: I am not ready to put my life in your hands. We need more time before you ask that again.
recruitment.reject.relationship.10: Let's keep talking and see how we manage before making any commitments.
recruitment.reject.relationship.2: You seem capable, but I do not know you well enough to join your group.
recruitment.reject.relationship.3: That is a serious promise. We have not built enough trust for me to make it.
recruitment.reject.relationship.4: Out here, joining up takes real trust. We aren't there yet.
recruitment.reject.relationship.5: I'm not looking to tie myself to people I barely know.
recruitment.reject.relationship.6: We haven't been through enough together for me to make that call.
recruitment.reject.relationship.7: Give it time. Asking someone to join your group isn't a small thing.
recruitment.reject.relationship.8: I appreciate the thought, but I need to see how you operate first.
recruitment.reject.relationship.9: I'm surviving on my own for now until I'm certain about who has my back.
recruitment.reject.unavailable.1: I cannot make that decision while I am unavailable.
recruitment.reject.unavailable.2: This is not a conversation I can have right now.
